provenance.coverage: 15 rows: color science (3), conformance outcomes on shipped and held-out palettes (8), API contract (4).
provenance.derivation: galactic-asshole-2 PR #6 (merged, closes #4, the m1-harness dispatch briefing) added scripts/ga2/palette_conformance.py. Agent files are exact base-commit bytes of scripts/ga2/{__init__,palette}.py and shared/factions/**/palette.json plus palette.schema.json; the module is a one-line docstring stub (a new file in the PR) so the base can be graded. TASK.md restates the briefing's AC-m1h-1..3 and the architecture tradeoff excerpt, with the oracle's literals stated (DEFAULT_TOLERANCE 12.0, conform when distance <= tolerance, worst distance 0 with no colors, unknown faction raises the loader's ValueError, public rgb_to_lab/delta_e_cie76 as imported by the PR's tests). AC-m1h-4 (PNG sampling via Pillow) is out of scope because the grader image has no image library; the oracle's lazy Pillow wrapper is kept but not probed. The reference is the merged module byte-for-byte. Hidden checks call the module on held-out colors and three held-out faction palettes (sandbox fixtures, not in the agent tree): Lab values of neutral and saturated colors, Euclidean CIE76 on arbitrary Lab pairs, conformance outcomes (exact anchors, AO shading, off-palette hues, single-anchor palettes, default and explicit tolerance boundaries with >=0.4 margin, empty input, one-shot iterables), offending colors as a set, and the unknown-faction error. Expected values are the oracle's, checked at 0.05.
